visual_review: Five representative rendered frames, full-resolution posters and both eight-frame timed contact sheets
changes_observed: Photographic workshop and outdoor lighting replace the simplified trees and grass
Thin PET, clear water, local reflections and molded surface detail replace the blue opaque appearance
Printed-part shading is smoother while every source STL vertex remains unchanged
Workbench grid, ruler and photographed asphalt establish physical scale
Launch cameras stay on the ground and look upward; the camera does not ascend with the rocket
Main viewing versions use only a small CG disclosure; engineering annotations are separate
remaining_limits: The bottle details and launcher are illustrative and unmeasured
Background HDRIs do not provide full geometric parallax
Water parcels are ballistic, not fluid breakup or splash CFD
No measured-flight, attitude, structural retention or recovery validation
Real-time full playback and actual audio listening were not performed
production: AI-assisted scene scripting, exact CAD, unchanged ODE trajectory, Cycles/OptiX rendering and original synthesized sound
claim: Photographic rendering improvement; CG rather than actual launch footage
